title: Panda holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M64 40 Q68 55 62 68' stroke='#f2f2f2' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='28' rx='13' ry='15' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
  <ellipse cx='61' cy='22' rx='3.5' ry='4.5' fill='#ff9fb0'/>
  <polygon points='64,42 68,42 66,46' fill='#e02a4c'/>
  <!-- panda body -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='78' rx='19' ry='16' fill='#f4f4f8'/>
  <!-- panda arms -->
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='74' rx='7' ry='10' fill='#3a3550' transform='rotate(20 26 74)'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='72' rx='7' ry='10' fill='#3a3550' transform='rotate(-25 58 72)'/>
  <!-- panda legs -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='92' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#3a3550'/>
  <ellipse cx='51' cy='92' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#3a3550'/>
  <!-- panda head -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='48' r='20' fill='#f4f4f8'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='32' r='7' fill='#3a3550'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='32' r='7' fill='#3a3550'/>
  <!-- eye patches -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='46' rx='7' ry='8.5' fill='#3a3550' transform='rotate(-15 34 46)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='7' ry='8.5' fill='#3a3550' transform='rotate(15 50 46)'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='46' r='2.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='46' r='2.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='35.6' cy='46.6' r='1.4' fill='#2a2540'/>
  <circle cx='49.6' cy='46.6' r='1.4' fill='#2a2540'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='55' rx='3.5' ry='2.5' fill='#3a3550'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M42 57.5 Q39 61 36.5 59' stroke='#3a3550' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M42 57.5 Q45 61 47.5 59' stroke='#3a3550' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='29' cy='54' r='3' fill='#ffb3c6' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='54' r='3' fill='#ffb3c6' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
